name: Amaya Tomoko
source:
"Today... won't you do anything to me?"

A high school student waiting for her father who has moved far away to earn money and settle their debt.

The apartment she used to live at burned down and she had ended up homeless. Found by Iwamori, she was taken in by him to live in an empty room he had in his apartment until her family's debt is returned.

Up until now she had no experience in sex, and her first time was taken by the protagonist. Afterwards, summoned on his whim, she shares the bed with Iwamori and eventually, she starts coming to his room out of her own volition.

[Translated from [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/6ninnotogime/chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
